title: On sections of Lefschetz fibrations and bundles over 2-complexes
summary: We address the question of existence of sections of fibrations in two settings. First, we show that a bundle with base a finite 2-complex admits a section if and only if the inclusion of the fiber is $π_1$-injective and the associated short exact sequence of fundamental groups splits. Second, for Lefschetz fibrations over the disk we provide a complete algebraic criterion characterizing which loops in the boundary mapping torus extend to continuous or smooth sections over the disk.
